prompt: Objective: decide whether a beverage company should enter the energy-drink market. What you've learned: the market is $2B and growing 8% a year. Latest finding: the top two brands hold 75% share. What is the best next step?

options.text: Find out how big the market will be in five years
options.feedback: Growth is already known (8% a year). The new question is whether the client can compete with two dominant brands.

options.text: Test whether the client could take share from the top two
options.feedback: Right. The market is attractive, but two brands hold 75%. Whether the client can take share decides it.

options.text: Map the distribution costs of a national launch
options.feedback: Useful once you know the client can win share, not before.

options.text: Check with the interviewer whether the client still wants to enter
options.feedback: Drive the case: the objective is already set. Propose the next analysis yourself.

explanation: Size and growth are known; two brands hold 75%. Before costs or launch plans, test whether the client has a way to win share.
